name: Cloakroom
desc1: The entrance to the inn is dusty, but well-maintained. A wooden rack
desc2: high on the wall provides a place to hang cloaks and other clothing.
desc3: Brass lamps affixed to the walls give off a din, warm light that
desc4: softens the hard angles of the stone. The inn's wooden door leads out
desc5: to the north, and an archway to the west leads into a large room.
